title: Baby Teeth
subtitle: They were taken away, leaving a bump in the smooth road.

trails.title: Old notebook
trails.description: A notebook pieced together with tattered pages, it tells of a gruesome Green Lake mystery.

items.speaker: Radio
items.text: Thank you for the letter, Emily. Now we're bringing our driver friends the latest weather forecast.

items.speaker: Radio
items.text: Ohio is having a sunny week, with a comfortable level of humidity and zero chance of rain.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Sorry, I forgot to switch off the in-built radio.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Sit tight and put on your seat belt. Hold the hands of people sitting next to you. If necessary, close your mouth and clench your teeth.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: You can do as I said, or not. I was mainly talking to "them."

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Yes, madam.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes, Ms. Tooth Fairy.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Are those little winged elves still nagging you? I remember you were troubled by them as early as I was in school.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: They are still there. They have never left there.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: The good thing is that they can't distinguish lies. They spend every second of their life overhearing me and totally believe what I say.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: As long as they hear me say, "Cover your mouth and clench your teeth," they will never attack you.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: We all owe Mr. Campbell a big "thank you" for this.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: All of his teeth were stolen when he was with Ms. Tooth Fairy. That's when humans finally realized how vindictive and vengeful those "little things" are.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: They stepped across the world for the cure. Eventually, they found a solution.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Mr. Campbell? Who is this person, and what happened to him?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: He is my brother. I am also a Campbell, Ms. Campbell. While he is a Mister.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: We shared a roof when we were little.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I was cursed for eating a toothfairy. It and its fellows swore to steal all my teeth.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: At first, they did it. I ate nine fairies and lost eleven baby teeth.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: My parents soon found out. They ordered special tooth braces for me in case I lose all my baby teeth and become a horrific old lady.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: In their second attack, those toothfairies failed to steal the teeth from Ms. Campbell, so they rushed to Mr. Campbell.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: His teeth disappeared in a flash, and he never had one since then.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: People said it was the curse of the toothfairy. Just like in books, the flying human-like critters are bigoted. Once gained, they will keep the love and hatred at heart forever.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I'm so sorry, Ms. Tooth Fairy. I shouldn't have asked.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Don't worry, sweetie. My brother now has his own teeth. He lives a stable life. The past is in the past.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: And, I don't really think he was cursed.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I've never heard the toothfairies swore at him, neither have I found any mark on him that can be detected by arcanum.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Instead of being cursed, what he suffered is more likely to be a "congenitally missing tooth," a term defined in human medical science.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I know that case. I just never thought Mr. Campbell lost his because of this.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: None of my classmates or instructors ever doubted the authenticity of such a curse when they gossiped of such things.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: SPDM is a community of a bunch of young arcanists and several instructors.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: For those kids, a curse is more common than a disease diagnosed by human medical science.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: As a result, they neglected what they can't comprehend and only learned the story from a one-sided perspective. Soon enough, rumors started to spread.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: But that was a curse—a trouble that you can't easily shake off once you're put under.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: People could hardly forget that. If toothfairies could curse his sister, they could also curse him. Everything came naturally. That was it.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Kids were ignorant for lack of knowledge, yet adults were ignorant for their cognitive inertia. In a story where truth and falsity are mingled together, it is hard to tell which is which.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: After all, life is not a show. You won't have a narrator to warn you of the dangers ahead.

items.speaker: Old Madman
items.text: Go away! Leave here!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Careful!

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: *coughs*

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, Ms. Tooth Fairy ... *coughs* Are you alright?!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We're good. Don't worry. Cover your mouth and nose. Get out of the car.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Is everyone okay? Did somebody get hurt? Timekeeper, you ...

items.speaker: Old Madman
items.text: Go away! Go! Go away! Get out of my woods!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ah!

items.speaker: Old Madman
items.text: I heard it! I, I heard it! I've … I've heard the God's will!

items.speaker: Old Madman
items.text: Oh God, oh God, I will guide your children, I will guide them ... guide them away from the demons ... ah ... from the land of demons!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Dilated pupils, disordered speech, and a body temperature of three degrees higher than the normal level. Presumably, he has taken some stimulants or substandard potions.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: His sanity has been taken away. We need to knock him out.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: He fainted out. Problem solved.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: But my car broke down. We have to walk there.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No problem, Ms. Tooth Fairy. I took the map with me before we got out. But there is smoke coming out of your car. Is it alright?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Don't worry, Vertin. My brother bought an insurance. The brokers will soon contact him.
